tpjkpcrg.baseName: My Christmas 6ft Slim Pre-Lit Christmas Tree with 180 LED Lights - Green
tpjkpcrg.variantName: My Christmas 6ft Slim Pre-Lit Christmas Tree with 180 LED Lights - Green
tpjkpcrg.sourceDescription: Bring festive style to your home with this slim pencil Christmas tree, designed to create a traditional Christmas display while taking up minimal floor space. Made with 720 green PVC tips, it offers a full, realistic appearance and is designed for repeated seasonal use. The tree is pre-lit with 180 dual-colour LED lights, providing warm white and cool white illumination to suit different festive styles. Choose from 9 lighting modes, including Combination, In Waves, Sequential, Slo-Glo, Flash, Slow Fade, Twinkle/Flash, Steady On and Off, using the included remote control to customise your display. A sturdy metal stand provides stability, while the simple assembly and disassembly make the tree convenient to store and reuse year after year. Available in 4ft, 5ft, 6ft and 7ft sizes, it is suitable for a variety of festive spaces. Specifications: Made from green PVC with 720 branch tips and 180 warm white and cool white LED lights. Features 9 lighting modes and an included remote control. Supplied with a sturdy metal stand. Available in 4ft, 5ft, 6ft and 7ft sizes. Dimensions: Available heights 4ft (122 cm), 5ft (152 cm), 6ft (183 cm) and 7ft (213 cm). Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG

s5ymfxv8.variantName: Christmas Tree World 6ft Frosted LED Pine Fibre Optic Tree
s5ymfxv8.sourceDescription: Looking for a fibre optic tree that looks just as good in the day as it does lit up in the evening? We've just the tree for you. Combining the nostalgic charm of a dark green Christmas tree and the contemporary benefits of a stunning LED fibre optic, the 6ft Frosted LED Pine marries the best of both festive worlds. Arriving pre-decorated with red berries, pine cones and frosted bottle-brush branches, you won't need to worry about adding Christmas tree decorations to the hassle-free wonder! Our customers love the ambient glow these trees emit with their bright flashing or static LED Christmas lights and adore the warm white fibres that add an elegant, frosted touch to the tips of your new favourite artificial tree. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. xqawyf3n.sourceDescription: Create a festive focal point around your Christmas tree with this pre-lit wooden tree skirt featuring a charming Northern Lights Snowman scene. The natural brown surround showcases decorative cut-out details illuminated by multicolour RGB LED lights. Choose from a range of lighting effects using the included remote control or the cable-mounted button. Designed for easy assembly, the panels slot together around your tree before or after decorating. Suitable for most 4ft to 6ft Christmas trees, including slim and fibre optic varieties, it accommodates tree stands up to 55cm diagonally, depending on stand shape. Powered by a low-voltage mains transformer for indoor use only. Features: Northern Lights Snowman scene with decorative cut-out details. Pre-lit with multicolour RGB LED lights. Multiple lighting effects with remote control included. Easy slot-together assembly. Suitable for most 4ft to 6ft Christmas trees. Fits tree stands up to 55cm diagonally Dimensions: H25.7 x W45.2 x D45.2cm. Christmas tree and decorations not included. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources.
